service_boundary: Represents the GroqCloud developer API, not GroqChat, Groq Playground, Groq hardware, individual hosted models, or third-party model publishers.
regional_controls: Reviewed documentation states that retained customer data is stored in United States Google Cloud buckets; the pilot does not claim customer-selected inference regions.
retention_controls: Inference inputs and outputs are not retained by default except for reliability or abuse handling; customers can enable Zero Data Retention. Batch, fine-tuning, and other stateful features have separate retention behavior.
routing: Customers select among models hosted by Groq; Flex processing changes capacity behavior but is not a multi-provider routing layer.
customization: Fine-tuning and LoRA state are documented as retained until customer deletion; support and availability remain model-specific.
strengths: The service documents production versus preview models, token-speed signals, and OpenAI-compatible access.
On-demand, Flex, and batch paths expose distinct capacity and workload tradeoffs.
tradeoffs: The hosted catalog is selective and preview models may be discontinued on short notice.
Regional choice is narrower than multi-region cloud platforms in the reviewed documentation.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.

upstream_disclosure.note: The customer data-processing addendum states the operator processes the content: "Groq will Process Personal Data only: (a) to provide, maintain, and support the Cloud Services and fulfill its obligations to Customer under the Agreement; (b) on Customer's behalf in compliance with Customer's documented instructions." The public trust centre carries a subprocessor list.
upstream_disclosure.scope: GroqCloud customer data-processing addendum, for GroqCloud

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: the quickstart says "Configure your API key as an environment variable" for the Groq-issued key, and every documented request uses it.

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching page states: "All cached data exists only in volatile memory and automatically expires within a few hours. No prompt or response content is ever stored in persistent storage or shared between organizations."

vulnerability_disclosure.note: A security.txt file is published with a contact address ("Contact: mailto:security@groq.com").

independent_audit.note: The public trust centre announces that the company "successfully maintained our SOC 2 Type II compliance, with our latest report now available as of 2025" and lists a "Groq, Inc. SOC2 Type II Report" behind a request-access control; nothing names GroqCloud, so it is recorded as undocumented for the named service.
independent_audit.scope: Groq trust centre, read for GroqCloud
